what: Under the big section title, a 0.5px horizontal line and a 32px vertical tick descending from its end are drawn separately — once the panel enters the 128px margin below the screen, it plays once: the line grows for .75s after .25s (from the right·left·center) and the tick grows for .5s after 1s (curve .5,.5,0,.95). The order ”title → line → tick” can be swapped to draw the tick first (.5s, bottom to top) and the line after, or replaced by two end ticks (brackets under a centered title)

options.from: Side the horizontal line grows from: left (default)·right·center
options.tick: Ticks: start (one at the left end, default) · ends (both ends) · none
options.tick-from: Side the ticks grow from: top (default)·bottom
options.x-dur · x-delay · y-dur · y-delay: Horizontal line and tick length and delay (seconds), default .75·.25·.5·1 — if ticks go first, y-delay: 0; x-delay: .5
options.start: ScrollTrigger start line, default top bottom+=128
options.on: When state, ignores scroll and draws only on the fx:show event
options.--fx-tick-h · --fx-line · --fx-line-colo: Tick height (default 32px) · line width (0.5px) · line color (--kf-ink)

note: Lines are drawn with the element’s ::before and ::after, so the element itself is an empty box (height = set as grid marks)

from.where: shared.css .rc-hline — capabilities·numbers section (from: right), process·about section (tick-from: bottom; y-delay: 0; x-delay: .5), commitment section (from: center; tick: ends)
